description: Dept. of Local Government Central Province - Mr. Y. M. Ranasinghe Yapa Bandara was Selected as Chairman of the Pathahewaheta Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the declaration of a Chairman for a local government authority (Pathahewaheta Pradeshiya Sabha) under Section 66 E of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with electoral results and declarations at the local government level, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
